commits.author: MissleToad
commits.message:
Add Dark Chaos 🚀 (#2090)

* Add Dark Chaos

Runs at 60FPS now with VLM! 🚀

* Update .yml

Removed duplicate directB2s image.  Updated hash

* Add Dark Chaos Tester Update

Fix Pbw23 typo

* Dark Chaos Launcher.png update

Udpated launcher.png

* Add Coffee Joe's Launcher

* Add Coffee Joe to testers

For his awesome launch add

* Update Dark Chaos .ini

multiple changes after bundle updates: AAFactor = 1 until its in defaults.  Squeezed what lighting I could out of it before FPS and stutters came in:  4kpVLMGIKeepPercent = 25
4kpVLMBakeBrightness = 2.500000
Using other new defaults:
RaytracedBallShadows = 0
Refraction = 0
ForceBloomOff = 1
